summary: Tested Verkocht (Sold) toggle, Celebrations, and Materials per Work Period features. All backend APIs working correctly. Fixed critical bug where new endpoints were defined AFTER app.include_router() causing 404 errors. Frontend UI verified - Verkocht switch visible on legacy documents, celebration modal working with confetti animation, materials section in Planning tab functional.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Endpoint definitions for celebrations, materials, and material-reminders were placed AFTER app.include_router(api_router) causing 404 errors. Moved them before the include_router call.
seed_data_creation: Used existing project 'Zinio & Amy' (PROJ-8DC83A0F) with legacy document DOC-2DBF0739 marked as sold. Celebration records created for both projects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features are working. Celebrations endpoint returns pending celebrations for admins. Material reminders endpoint returns work periods with materials starting within 1 month. Verkocht toggle on quotes and legacy documents updates project status to 'in uitvoering' and creates celebration records.

PUT /api/quotes/{quote_id} with is_sold=.details: Updates project status to 'in uitvoering' and creates celebration record

PUT /api/legacy-documents/{doc_id} with.details: Updates project status to 'in uitvoering' and creates celebration record

GET /api/celebrations/pending.details: Returns list of unseen celebrations for current admin user

POST /api/celebrations/{id}/mark-seen.details: Adds current user to seen_by array

POST /api/projects/{project_id}/schedule.details: Adds material to work period with unique ID

GET /api/dashboard/material-reminders.details: Returns work periods with materials starting within 1 month

Frontend: Verkocht switch on legacy docu.details: Switch visible in Offertes tab of project detail page. Shows green toggle and 'VERKOCHT' badge when enabled.

Frontend: Celebration modal.details: Modal appears on admin login with confetti animation, trophy icon, project name, and sale amount. Dismiss button works.

Frontend: Materials section in Planning.details: Each work period shows expandable 'Materialen' section with count. Can add/remove materials.

bug_fixed.issue: New API endpoints returning 404 Not Found
bug_fixed.root_cause: Endpoint definitions for /api/celebrations/pending, /api/celebrations/{id}/mark-seen, /api/projects/{project_id}/scheduled-days/{period_id}/materials, and /api/dashboard/material-reminders were placed AFTER app.include_router(api_router) at line 5984. FastAPI only registers routes that are defined BEFORE include_router is called.
bug_fixed.fix: Moved all new endpoint definitions to before the app.include_router(api_router) call
